_note: The NX-T R2b arm table (data-driven; owner rulings 323 and 325 A of 2026-10-17: raise the Solver's reasoning budget and completion cap so Solver reasoning is no longer truncated; ONE candidate arm). No node cap may exceed fragment_completion_cap, which is the largest cap of any arm node and names the serving fragment (...-budget3072-max<fragment_completion_cap>-v1).
